specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: The Tiago is powered by a 1.2-litre Revotron three-cylinder 12V petrol that produces 86 BHP (64;kW) power and 114 N⋅m (84 lb⋅ft; 12 kg⋅m) of maximum torque combined with a 5-speed manual transmission or 5-speed AMT, or a 1.1-litre Revotorq three-cylinder diesel engine producing 69 BHP (51 kW) of power and 140 N⋅m (103 lb⋅ft; 14 kg⋅m) of maximum torque, combined with a 5-speed manual transmission.

specs.name: price
specs.source_sentence: A very heavy facelift of the Tiago and Tiago.ev was launched on 28 May 2026 with prices starting from ₹4.7 Lakh for ICE  and ₹7.0 Lakh for the EV variants.

specs.name: acceleration
specs.source_sentence: According to Tata, the car can accelerate from 0–100 kilometres per hour (0–62 mph) in under 10 seconds.
